heading: Wednesday Night
text: Mostly cloudy. Chance of rain or snow showers from New York into southwestern Vermont late. Lows in the upper 20s to lower 30s east, low to mid 30s west. Winds diminishing to light and variable.

heading: Thursday
text: Cloudy. Rain likely in the valleys south and west of Interstate 89, a rising chance north and east, reaching the Northeast Kingdom and northern New Hampshire in the afternoon; any rain changing to snow over high terrain, with a trace to 2 inches, mainly in the Adirondacks and southern Greens. Valley highs from the upper 30s to mid 40s. East to northeast winds 5 to 10 mph.

heading: Thursday Night
text: Chance of rain or snow showers far north; otherwise rain mixing with or changing to snow in the valleys, and snow over high terrain; a trace to an inch of snow in the valleys, mainly south; a trace 2 inches of snow over high terrain from the northern Greens eastward, 2 to 5 inches over high terrain elsewhere, with highest amounts in the Adirondacks and southern Greens. Lows from the upper 20s to mid 30s. North to northeast winds 5 to 15 mph, gusting to 25 mph in the Champlain Valley.
